Complete, Roman silver denarius of Hadrian (AD 117-138) dating to the period AD 134 to 138. Mint of Rome. RIC II, p. 369, no. 256. Reece Period 6. Obverse inscription: [HA]DRIANVS AVG. Obverse description: Bare head right. Reverse inscription: MONET AVG. Reverse description: Moneta standing left holding scales and cornucopiae
